description: Cross-chain best-execution comparison for a tokenized equity ticker (NVDA, SPY, TSLA, ...). Ranks HIP-3, Arcus, RH Uniswap, Solana xStocks, and TON. Returns winner + runners-up + bestPreparable (only rh_uniswap is preparable in v1). rankedOn is usually gross because fees/gas are unmeasured - say so. Never signs.

horizonHours.description: optional holding horizon; enables funding-adjusted spot-vs-perp ranking

sizeUsd.description: optional notional USD size for impact model

ticker.description: equity ticker, e.g. NVDA, SPY, TSLA

name: equity_quote
